results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff (p * Polynomial.X ^ n) (d + n) = coeff p d := by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (d, n), coeff_X_pow, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h1 h2
    rw [coeff_X_pow, if_neg, mul_zero]
    grind [mem_antidiagonal]
  · grind [mem_antidiagonal]

results.name: Polynomial.coeff_X_pow
results.source_text:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem coeff_X_pow (k n : ℕ) : coeff (X ^ k : R[X]) n = if n = k then 1 else 0 := by
  simp only [one_mul, map_one, ← coeff_C_mul_X_pow]

results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow'
results.source_text:
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow' (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    (p * X ^ n).coeff d = ite (n ≤ d) (p.coeff (d - n)) 0 := by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, coeff_mul_X_pow, add_tsub_cancel_right]
  · refine (coeff_mul _ _ _).trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [coeff_X_pow, if_neg, mul_zero]
    exact ((le_of_add_le_right (mem_antidiagonal.mp hx).le).trans_lt <| not_le.mp h).ne

results.name: Polynomial.coeff_pow_of_natDegree_le
results.source_text:
theorem coeff_pow_of_natDegree_le (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p ^ m).coeff (m * n) = p.coeff n ^ m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m hm =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ← hm, Nat.succ_mul, coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le _ pn]
    refine natDegree_pow_le.trans (le_trans ?_ (le_refl _))
    gcongr

results.name: Polynomial.X
EuclideanDomain.div_self
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem div_self {a : R} (a0 : a ≠ 0) : a / a = 1 := by
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_div_cancel_right₀ 1 a0

results.name: EuclideanDomain.div_div
results.source_text:
theorem div_div {x y z : R} (h1 : y ∣ x) (h2 : z ∣ (x / y)) :
    x / y / z = x / (y * z) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy
  · simp only [div_zero, zero_div, zero_mul]
  rw [← mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hy, EuclideanDomain.mul_div_cancel' hy h1] at h2
  exact (div_mul h1 h2).symm

results.name: EuclideanDomain.mod_self
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem mod_self (a : R) : a % a = 0 :=
  mod_eq_zero.2 dvd_rfl

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd
results.source_text:
/-- `gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
  any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b` -/
def gcd (a b : R) : R :=
  if a0 : a = 0 then b
  else
    have _ := mod_lt b a0
    gcd (b % a) a
termination_by a
results.docstring:
`gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b`

results.name: EuclideanGeometry.oangle
results.source_text:
/-- The oriented angle at `p₂` between the line segments to `p₁` and `p₃`, modulo `2 * π`. If
either of those points equals `p₂`, this is 0. See `EuclideanGeometry.angle` for the
corresponding unoriented angle definition. -/
def oangle (p₁ p₂ p₃ : P) : Real.Angle :=
  o.oangle (p₁ -ᵥ p₂) (p₃ -ᵥ p₂)
results.docstring:
The oriented angle at `p₂` between the line segments to `p₁` and `p₃`, modulo `2 * π`. If
either of those points equals `p₂`, this is 0. See `EuclideanGeometry.angle` for the
corresponding unoriented angle definition.

results.name: EuclideanGroup
results.source_text:
/-- An n-dimensional `Euclidean group` is a group of
rotations, reflections, and translations.
-/
@[ext]
structure EuclideanGroup (n : ℕ) where
  /-- The translation part of a Euclidean transformation. -/
  translation : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)
  /-- The orthogonal linear part of a Euclidean transformation. -/
  linear : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ
results.docstring:
An n-dimensional `Euclidean group` is a group of
rotations, reflections, and translations.

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
